name: instant-insanity
title: Instant Insanity (instant-insanity)
statements: There are four cubes. Each face of a cube is red, green, blue, white or yellow.

Each cube is given by its three pairs of opposite faces: cube 1: red and green, blue and white, red and yellow; cube 2: green and blue, yellow and red, white and white; cube 3: yellow and white, green and red, blue and blue; cube 4: blue and red, white and yellow, green and green.
You stack the four cubes in a column, each turned any way you like.
The column has four sides: front, back, left and right.
The goal is that each of the four sides of the column shows four different colours.

assumptions.text: "turned any way you like": each cube has one orientation object per distinct assignment of colours to the four sides (front, back, left, right); the top and bottom faces do not matter. Cube 1 has 24, cubes 2 to 4 have 16 (each has a pair of equal colours).
"stack in a column": cubes are placed one at a time in the order 1, 2, 3, 4, each on the one before; cube 1 goes on the ground, which counts as placed from the start.
"four different colours" on a side: two placed cubes showing the same colour on the same side is a losing state, so a partial column that cannot be completed is cut off at once.
